note: Named, bounded policy parameters. A parameter with no stated finite maximum is not 'bounded'; an implementation-chosen ceiling such as Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER does not satisfy a bound.

parameters.note: The largest use_limit a worker_dispatch authorization may carry. use_limit is REQUIRED, a positive integer, and at most this value.
Total attempts for one exact operation on one exact tuple: the first attempt plus at most one retry, and only where a trusted terminal INFRA_ABORT supports it.
Two completed-verdict rounds per slice; PR-F carries three and PR-I one. Extending a budget is a Founder decision, not a policy edit.

infrastructure_retry.shape: the first attempt, plus at most one retry
infrastructure_retry.retry_precondition: the previous attempt ended in a trusted terminal INFRA_ABORT classified by a reviewer or provider, never self-classified by a worker
infrastructure_retry.concurrency: retries are never concurrent; at most one attempt for an operation may be in flight
infrastructure_retry.attempt_identity: each attempt carries its own durable attempt identity
infrastructure_retry.on_exhaustion: before a third attempt the task becomes BLOCKED with an INFRASTRUCTURE obligation and returns to the Founder
infrastructure_retry.budget: an infrastructure abort consumes no completed-verdict round
infrastructure_retry.unknown_effects_excluded: This rule does not apply to an external effect whose outcome is UNKNOWN. Such an effect is never blindly re-sent: it is probed by redemption_key first and re-executed only when the probe confirms non-application and the provider contract proves same-key retry safe.
